label: PREDICTED by the simulator before any GPU run of the pressure preset, on the fallback T4 config
probe: Before the main sweep: one launch of the fcfs_p server on the chosen config, then fcfs-p/spec and fcfs-p/spec+bad at 4 agents, once each. If fcfs-p/spec+bad shows neither a preemption (vllm:num_preemptions) nor a queue (vllm:num_requests_waiting > 0 in any 1-second sample), the sweep runs on the fallback config and is scored against results/prereg_v4_fallback; otherwise on the chosen config, scored against results/prereg_v4. The predicted probe values are each set's `pressure` rows.
decision_rule: The rule: the plugin wins if its session p50 is at least 5% below the cap's at 4 agents, in either workload (plugin-p/spec+bad vs cap-p/spec+bad, or plugin-p/both vs cap-p/both), with the pressure check passed. Decided on the measured values, not on these claims' verdicts. Each set's `d1` is the simulated answer.

rules.validity: A measured point counts only if every run has status ok and its row's cpu_ok is true (whole-host CPU < 0.85 mean, < 10% of seconds >= 95% busy). Otherwise every claim using it is 'invalid'.
rules.ratio: measured ratio m of two measured points vs predicted p: supported if |m - p| <= tol; refuted if |m - p| > tol and the numerator's 95% CI does not overlap p x the denominator's 95% CI (both from vllm_bench.summarize's bootstrap); otherwise unresolved. Eager ratios use eager points only.
rules.fraction: measured share of decoys logged 'rejected' vs predicted: supported if within tol (absolute), otherwise refuted.
rules.points: for every measured (arm, load), |log(predicted / measured)| of session p50 and root TPOT p50 for P1, P0 and P1-alt: median and max, P1's in-sample points (1/4/8 agents of fcfs/* and plugin/*) apart from the rest. Not pass/fail.
rules.pressure: Claims PR, PC, PP use v3's ratio rule and PF v3's fraction rule (decoys logged rejected, which includes a bet dropped before its first token). The denominators are fcfs-p/spec+bad (PR), cap (PC) and priority (PP), all at 4 agents on the same config. No point here is in-sample for P1: its seq_cap was fit on the October 19 rows, none of them a pressure arm.

reading_rules: **Pooled p50s sit on pattern clusters.** The 16 sessions of a run are 4 of each mix4 pattern, and patterns differ by up to 3x in session time. The pooled p50 is the lowest session of the third-fastest pattern, so a small change in one pattern can move it a lot. Read every session_p50 claim with `prereg_compare.py`'s per-pattern ratios (geometric mean over patterns).

**Why cap and plugin lose in `both`.** In mix4 the shadow forces nearly every speculation, and spec-ptc's shadow stops for the rest of the turn when it forces a refused bet (shadow.py _abort('force-failed')). The window of 8 refuses most real bets at 4 agents, so these arms run close to no speculation: the claims predict cap-p/both and plugin-p/both well above fcfs-p/spec+bad (PR) and the plugin well above priority (PP-2). Simulated with the shadow re-running a refused call instead, the loss would be far smaller (results/pressure README, sensitivity 'reissue').

**What the claims cannot show.** PC-1..4 test the decision rule's ratios, but the rule is applied to the measured values. A claim refuted in the plugin's favour can still leave the rule unmet, and the reverse.
**The sim's KV model under heavy preemption is unchecked** (a known risk): the probe values (preemptions, queue, KV peak) are predictions too, not inputs.
